title: `PERCENTILE_CONT` interpolates at (n - 1)·p
description: `PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25)` of 1, 2, 4, 10 is 1.75 and `MEDIAN` 3: linear at position (n - 1)·p. `PERCENTILE_DISC(0.25)` is 1 and `(0.5)` 2, the first value whose cumulative share reaches p, of the input's type (`NUMBER(2,0)`). `MEDIAN` of integers is a `NUMBER` with 3 more places, of doubles a double.
reference: `quantile_interp`: any value between the neighbours; the YAML's `quantile_disc`: native.

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT median(x), percentile_cont(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x), percentile_disc(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x), percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x), percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(median(x)), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(percentile_disc(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY x)) FROM (VALUES (1), (2), (4), (10)) AS s(x)

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
